description: AI governance and assurance, not lifecycle-bound. Identifier handoff (subject_hash), not a computed value passed on. Two-step quarterly evidence flow: bind a sealed artifact into a subject identifier, then compose the quarter's testing-evidence pack tied to that subject. Stop condition before step 2: proceed only when step 1 reports binding_complete true and producer_pinned true; a pack built over an incomplete or unpinned subject is labelled not attested.
name: attested-subject-to-quarterly-test-evidence-pack

steps.handoff: Then the step 2 run takes the step 1 output's subject_hash unchanged by name and wraps the pack's per-test receipt digests into an evidence bundle tied to that subject

Then, only when the stop condition holds (binding_complete true and producer_pinned true), the quarterly testing-evidence pack is composed and its per-test receipt digests are wrapped into an evidence bundle tied to subject_hash; otherwise the pack is labelled not attested
Then the session receipts are aggregated into the session receipt

title: Attested Subject to Quarterly Test Evidence Pack
